test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank

Philosophers dating all the way back to Plato and the Ancient Greeks_______ placed significant emphasis on education.
solution:
The correct answer is '**have**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**have**" is used here as the sentence subjects are "**Philosophers dating all the way back to Plato and the Ancient Greeks**."
 
• The sentence structure requires the present perfect tense, so "**have placed**" is the correct form.
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Philosophers dating all the way back to Plato and the Ancient Greeks **have__** placed significant emphasis on education."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "have been"** is incorrect because it would require additional context or a different sentence structure.
 
• **Option 3: "has"** is incorrect because the subject "Philosophers" is plural.
 
• **Option 4: "was"** is incorrect because it does not fit the present perfect tense required here.
